data.missingForecastBehavior: Retained common ledger grid includes fallback rows where 2026 Summer forecasts are absent; these rows are not complete strategy evidence.

signalInstrument.role: Retained schedule session grid; automatic Summer price-confirmation and reversion gates are disabled.

pnlInstrument.role: All gas-sleeve P&L and reporting; no candidate ranking in the fixed builder.

execution.priceConvention: Yahoo daily split-and-distribution-adjusted open and close
execution.selectionRule: cost and execution parameters are frozen before candidate evaluation and must never be optimized for return
execution.costCalibration: aggregate all-in research allowances; replace only with a separately versioned calibration built from stored historical quotes and fills
execution.borrowBasis: default live routing opens UNG shorts only when Alpaca reports easy-to-borrow status

baseline.borrowBasis: default live routing opens UNG shorts only when Alpaca reports easy-to-borrow status

contract.fallback: Unallocated deployable capital is routed to the configured VOO/QQQM target-weight index basket; the broker cash buffer remains uninvested.
contract.signalTiming: Forecast issue-date signals are used only on later trading sessions. Prior holdings earn close-to-open returns; current targets earn adjusted-open-to-close returns.
contract.reversionTiming: Disabled: no automatic Summer short or fade.
contract.weatherResolutionTiming: No Summer fade leg; weather-resolution fade sizing does not apply.
contract.heatSignalFreshness: Keep the fixed three-calendar-day heat-follow freshness rule.
contract.storageDeficitHeatTilt: Fresh summer heat-follow exposure is multiplied by 1.25x, capped at 0.4375x notional, only when the latest EIA Lower 48 storage report available before the session open is below its trailing 5-year seasonal average.
contract.storageTiming: Storage rows are available only at a session open after their timestamp in the versioned EIA WNGSR release calendar; a missing release-calendar row fails artifact generation.
contract.selectionPolicy: Operator-selected fixed no-shorts plus zero/zero supply filter. No parameter optimization or holdout-based selection in this builder.
contract.sourceWeighting: Fixed equal weights across the selected GFS and GEFS source families; no reliability-weight fitting.

selected.architectureLabel: Fresh heat long with storage and released supply-pressure filter
selected.architectureDescription: Retain fixed weather-follow sizing and timing. No Summer automatic fade or short. Suppress heat longs only when seasonal storage is above normal and same-vintage production growth exceeds LNG-export growth.

promotion.reason: Historical weather remains legacy hours-0 and 2026 Summer coverage is incomplete. Paper routing is independent of research promotion.

realityCheck.comparison: strategy net daily return minus US index basket daily return
realityCheck.interpretation: Reporting-only, development-contaminated legacy inputs; not independent evidence.

temporalContract.targetDateSemantics: The targetDate remains issueDate plus leadDays. Offset 24 samples the following UTC midnight and is aggregated into that targetDate as the reviewed Eastern/Central US local-day approximation.

valueBinding.acquisitionTrustBoundary: The builder hashes each fetched GRIB field or Open-Meteo response and binds that digest plus upstream object identity into the persisted score provenance. Relabel-only or accidental value changes fail validation. Raw forecast bytes are not retained and SHA-256 bindings are not signatures, so a malicious process able to fabricate values and recompute every digest remains inside the trusted builder acquisition-attestation boundary.

policy.marketCutoff: Require each in-season lead-7 issue date to have its target date on or before the aligned market ledger end; the initial calendar is reviewed as beginning 2021-05-01.
